candidates.change_summary: Replace assignment to owner with assigning admin instead of the provided _owner, so setOwner sets owner = admin.
Remove the assignment to owner so setOwner no longer changes owner but still returns true.
Assign owner to the zero address instead of the provided _owner, so setOwner sets owner = address(0).
Invert the order: first set owner to _owner, then overwrite it with msg.sender, causing owner to become msg.sender after call.
Change the onlyAdmin require to compare against owner instead of admin, so only admin-only functions now require msg.sender == owner.
Change setOwner to update owner but return false instead of true, altering the function's return value while still completing.

Modify onlyAdmin modifier to allow any caller (remove the require), so setOwner executes for non-admins and returns true as before — this changes which callers can successfully call setOwner but keeps the same return value for admin; however when called by non-admins it will now complete and return true (different observable behavior for some callers).
Removed the onlyAdmin modifier requirement by deleting the modifier invocation on setOwner, allowing any caller to change owner.
Tightened the onlyAdmin check to compare against owner instead of admin, changing who can call admin-only functions (including setOwner if modifier used).
Weakened the onlyAdmin check to allow anyone (removed require), so setOwner becomes callable by any caller if modifier present.
